text:
Alex Chen: Quick cross-check — Q3 OKR milestone status: model-compat rollout, infra autoscale, docs/core-eval sets. I pulled a short list of what shipped vs slipped. Can owners confirm next actions + blockers? :eyes:

Maya Patel: I own model-compat rollout. Shipped the initial canary yesterday, metrics look good except tail latency at p95 on long prompts. I'm going to throttle batch sizes for canary and re-run perf tests today. No SLA impact yet.

Samir Rao: Infra autoscale is the one that slipped — blocked on a quota request for GPU burst nodes (cloud team). PR is up for the autoscaler changes but awaiting infra-approval. @Priya can you share the quota ETA?

Priya Kapoor: Quota request is escalated, cloud responded with tentative approval by EOD tomorrow. We'll get a follow up once allocation is confirmed. In the meantime I can provision a small dedicated pool for the prioritized routes.

Jin Park: Docs + eval sets: docs PRs are in review (two small pieces). Eval harness needs a new prompt set for long sequences — I'll pair with Maya to ensure we capture tail latency cases.

Alex Chen: Ownership check — model-compat: Maya; autoscale infra changes: Samir; quota provisioning: Priya; docs + eval: Jin. Ack?

Maya Patel: Ack. I'll post perf diffs after the throttle run.

Samir Rao: Ack. I'll move the autoscaler PR to ready-for-merge once cloud confirms quota. Patch note: we added a safety fallback to lower concurrency when quota is low.

Priya Kapoor: Ack. If quota arrives we can do a quick smoke deploy and keep traffic routed to legacy nodes as fallback.

Jin Park: Ack. I'll add the new prompt set to the eval repo and leave a note for release notes.

Alex Chen: Couple of small dependency calls: 1) Maya -> needs an extra test token from infra for canary (Samir/ops). 2) Jin -> needs the model artifact namespace from release infra. Can we get these within the next 24h?

Samir Rao: I can generate a short-lived test token. Deploy-bot will post the details.

deploy-bot: Canary token created: token-xxf3... (expires 24h). Posted to #secure-ops.

Priya Kapoor: Model artifact namespace is ready, @Jin — I'll DM the path and permissions.

Alex Chen: Cool. Risks: if quota delays >48h then autoscale slip affects ramp for dedicated customers. Mitigation: we keep canary routing to legacy model and schedule a customer-facing notice if extended. Agree?

Maya Patel: Agree on mitigation. I'll hold the wider rollout until autoscale is green.

Samir Rao: Sounds good. Action items summary: Maya — perf diffs + hold wider rollout; Samir — follow up quota + merge autoscaler; Priya — confirm quota & share namespace; Jin — eval prompt set + docs PR. I'll update the OKR tracking doc after this thread.

Alex Chen: Thanks everyone. If any blockers pop up drop a DM or ping here. I'll follow up in the OKR doc and mark this thread for the weekly sync. :thumbsup:
